extraction.NOTES: This is a cover letter from A. W. Leech, Superintendent, transmitting reports for multiple allottees including: 32- James J. Sweeney for his deceased wife Laura Dean and their minor child (report in detail attached); 33- Nicholas Trombla (ditto); 34- Rosa Vanderbloom (ditto); 35- Viola Wallace (ditto); 36- Mary A. Wallace (report mailed to her, not returned). The letter notes that the listed Indians are scattered far and wide over the United States, a number have not been heard from for years and their present whereabouts is unknown. Mimeograph forms were mailed to each known address; some were returned unclaimed, others were never returned. The office was unable to submit a report in detail for each and every allottee.
